stories.title: Details emerge in case of former Cornell student alleging rape by frat members

en.title: Details emerge in case of former Cornell student alleging rape by frat members
en.summary: A woman identified as Jane Doel alleges she was gang-raped by seven fraternity members in 2024 and claims Cornell University failed to protect her.

stories.title: Jack Smith Defends Trump Charges as Senator’s Perjury Claim Falls Apart

en.title: Jack Smith Defends Trump Charges as Senator's Perjury Claim Falls Apart
en.summary: A Republican senator attempting to demonstrate misconduct by the former special counsel appeared instead to display confusion about fundamental facts in the matter.

stories.title: Trump and tech leaders sign "morally-binding" AI "constitution" in safety push

en.title: Trump and tech leaders sign "morally-binding" AI "constitution" in safety push
en.summary: President Trump and major artificial intelligence leaders signed a document at the White House intended to establish self-regulation and safety standards for AI development.

stories.title: Supreme Court allows rapid deportations to 3rd countries, agrees to hear case

en.title: Supreme Court allows rapid deportations to 3rd countries, agrees to hear case
en.summary: The Supreme Court blocked a lower court order that had prevented the Trump administration from deporting migrants to third countries without advance notification.

stories.title: Venezuelan man shot and wounded by ICE agent in Texas is charged with assaulting an officer

en.title: Venezuelan man shot and wounded by ICE agent in Texas is charged with assaulting an officer
en.summary: A Venezuelan man was shot by an ICE officer in Texas while making food deliveries. His legal representatives report that a bullet remains lodged in his spine, presenting serious health risks.

stories.title: New questions emerge over 2024 investigation into alleged Cornell rape

en.title: New questions emerge over 2024 investigation into alleged Cornell rape
en.summary: A student's attorney claims Cornell's campus police did not adequately follow up on evidence in an alleged sexual assault case. The university maintains that police conducted an investigation and coordinated with the district attorney's office as standard procedure.

stories.title: Supreme Court Allows Trump Administration’s Third-Country Deportations, for Now

en.title: Supreme Court Allows Trump Administration's Third-Country Deportations, for Now
en.summary: The Supreme Court temporarily allowed the Trump administration's third-country deportation policy to continue while scheduling December arguments to determine its legality. The policy enables rapid deportation of immigrants to nations other than their own.

stories.title: Man Shot by ICE Agent in Austin Is Charged With Assault

en.title: Man Shot by ICE Agent in Austin Is Charged With Assault
en.summary: A man has been charged with assault after prosecutors say he struck an ICE agent with his car's mirror before being shot. Body camera footage of the incident exists but has not been made public.

stories.title: Supreme Court allows ‘third country’ deportations to resume for now

en.title: Supreme Court allows 'third country' deportations to resume for now
en.summary: The Supreme Court permitted the Trump administration's policy of deporting migrants to countries where they are not citizens to proceed temporarily. The court will hear full arguments and issue a final ruling on the controversial practice later.

stories.title: U.S. Supreme Court sides with Trump administration in third-country deportations

en.title: U.S. Supreme Court sides with Trump administration in third-country deportations
en.summary: The Supreme Court permitted the Trump administration to resume deportations of migrants to countries not specified in their removal orders and agreed to hear full arguments on the case.

stories.title: Supreme Court allows Trump’s ‘third country’ deportation policy

en.title: Supreme Court allows Trump's 'third country' deportation policy
en.summary: The Supreme Court has upheld a deportation policy allowing immigrants to be sent to countries without prior connection. This marks the second time the court has rejected lower court challenges to the practice.

stories.title: Jack Smith clashes with senators over Trump probes, says he will not be silenced

en.title: Jack Smith clashes with senators over Trump probes, says he will not be silenced
en.summary: Former special counsel Jack Smith testified before lawmakers defending his efforts to prosecute Trump, stating he will not be deterred by threats of prosecution from the president.

stories.title: Oil Remains Elevated Despite Persian Gulf Exports Recovery

en.title: Oil Remains Elevated Despite Persian Gulf Exports Recovery
en.summary: Oil prices remain high even as exports from the Persian Gulf have increased through the Strait of Hormuz, including alternative ship-to-ship transfer methods, according to Goldman Sachs analysis.

stories.title: Yen’s Long-Term Trend Has Likely Turned to Appreciation

en.title: Yen's Long-Term Trend Has Likely Turned to Appreciation
en.summary: The yen is expected to strengthen over the long term as the Bank of Japan implements rate increases and Japanese interest rates rise, according to Citi.

stories.title: Gold Steady; Markets Await U.S. Economic Data

en.title: Gold Steady; Markets Await U.S. Economic Data
en.summary: Gold prices remained stable in early Asian trading as declines from the previous day stabilized, supported by easing oil prices, treasury yields, and reduced expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes.

stories.title: Wall Street’s Hopes for a Blockbuster IPO Season Are Fading

en.title: Wall Street's Hopes for a Blockbuster IPO Season Are Fading
en.summary: Anticipated major initial public offerings for the fall are encountering headwinds from market volatility and investor concerns about artificial intelligence safety risks.

stories.title: The Gap Between the Rich and the Very, Very Rich Is Getting Wider

en.title: The Gap Between the Rich and the Very, Very Rich Is Getting Wider
en.summary: The wealthiest 0.1% of households hold approximately $28 trillion in wealth, representing about 15% of total national wealth, with average household wealth exceeding $200 million in this group.
